national_news.title: COP31 Climate Summit Commences in Antalya, Turkey
bullets: The 31st Conference of Parties (COP31) to the UNFCCC began in Antalya, Turkey, bringing together delegates from nearly 200 countries.
The summit aims to accelerate clean energy, scale up climate finance, and strengthen global climate resilience.
The World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) is scheduled to release its flagship State of Climate update 2026 during the conference.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Significant Reduction in Left-Wing Extremism During Bastar Visit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi celebrated Diwali with security personnel at a Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) camp at Karanpur in Bastar, Chhattisgarh.
Highlighted that for the first time in 47 years, not a single CRPF jawan lost their life on duty in the past year, marking significant progress against Left Wing Extremism (LWE).
Noted a substantial decline in Naxal-affected districts from over 230 districts across nearly 20 states in previous decades to nationwide eradication.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Calls for Enhanced Cyber Resilience and Operational Preparedness
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel at Air Force Station Bagdogra in West Bengal, urging high operational readiness against asymmetric warfare and drone swarms.
Highlighted the Cabinet's approval of the 'Second Tour of Duty' for Agniveers, enabling eligibility for enrolment as regular soldiers post their two-year engagement subject to selection criteria.
Emphasized the push for 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' in defense manufacturing through Indian startups developing indigenous drones, anti-drone systems, and cybersecurity equipment.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Reaffirms E20 Fuel Adherence to BIS Quality Standards
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas confirmed that E20 petrol supplied by public sector Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) complies with Bureau of Indian Standards specification IS 17021.
A total of 893 samples tested across 27 States and UTs, including 56 samples in Karnataka, verified ethanol blending within the prescribed 19% to 20% limit.
Public sector OMCs—Indian Oil Corporation, Bharat Petroleum Corporation, and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation—maintain standardized quality assurance procedures across distribution networks.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department to Recruit 11,000 Staff Members
bullets: The State Health Society, Bihar (SHSB) is set to release a recruitment notification for over 11,000 healthcare positions in November.
The recruitment drive covers medical support, technical, administrative, and clerical posts across all 38 districts of Bihar.
The hiring process aims to address manpower shortages from district hospitals down to primary health centres (PHCs) and panchayat levels.
